topic: Will the world's population keep growing indefinitely?
uncertainties_to_preserve: Projection outputs are conditional on modeled assumptions.
Climate-disruption effects cannot be assumed to be identifiable or homogeneous.
A global total may conceal offsetting national and age-structure changes.
idea_constraints: Do not claim a single inevitable peak year.
Make continued growth after 2100 a testable posterior decision, not a narrative assertion.
Retain a no-climate baseline and a climate-ablation test.
